issues.description: Attribute mismatch for GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit.number_of_qubits_query_register: the template initializes this attribute to a float value 0.0 and immediately uses it to construct a QuantumRegister, whereas the solution and the problem statement expect an integer 2 (two-qubit register). QuantumRegister requires an integer number of qubits; using 0.0 (float) will raise a TypeError when constructing the register and prevents students from running the starter code. This inconsistency between the template, the solution, and the exercise text will block students from executing the template and is not a pedagogical missing-implementation gap.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, set number_of_qubits_query_register to an integer matching the exercise (two qubits). For example: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2. Ensure the value is an int (not a float) so QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register) constructs correctly. This aligns the template with the problem statement and the solution and prevents a runtime TypeError.
